gaps.explanation: Statement p5 (Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Modified Cash Basis - Governmental Funds) Total Governmental Funds total revenues 1,257,091 = General 719,191 + Street 212,697 + Debt Service 130,303 + Keno 114 + ARPA 93,361 + TIF 101,425. Detail holds General Fund combining schedule pp15-16 (719,192), Street budget p13 (212,697) and Debt Service budget p14 (130,303) = 1,062,192. The Keno Fund (Keno revenue 84, Interest income 30), ARPA Fund (Contributions and grants 93,361) and TIF Fund (Other 101,425; shown as Tax Increment Financing on the Statement of Activities p3 and carried as TIF Proceeds, category property tax, on the statement lines) columns have no schedule. Added 84 + 30 + 93,361 + 101,425 = 194,900. Check: 1,062,192 + 194,900 = 1,257,092 vs 1,257,091; the remaining 1 is the General Fund combining schedule's printed total 719,192 vs the statement's 719,191 (Other 11,706 vs 11,705, rounding printed by the report).
